in_marathi.name: Mrutyunjay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mrutyunjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Mrutyunjay is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Mrutyu' meaning death and 'Njay' meaning conqueror. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is believed to have the power to conquer death. It is a powerful and auspicious name for a baby boy in Hindu tradition.
